verdict.rationale: Postmark documents inbound processing: you configure an inbound server, inbound email is parsed and delivered to a webhook, and it supports inbound domain forwarding, inbound blocking rules with bypass, and retrying failed inbound messages. That covers parse-and-POST plus basic filtering. Nothing shows rule-based routing that matches on recipient or pattern and sends mail to different endpoints, forwards it, or stores it per rule. Multiple endpoints are only implied by the ability to create several servers or streams. Missing for 10: per-recipient or pattern-match routing rules, choosing forward/store/POST per rule, multiple webhook destinations per inbound domain, detailed rule documentation and hands-on corroboration.
